title: Bashiqa, Mar Mattai & Nineveh
full_text:
After breakfast, start heading to explore Bashiqa, in this city, visitors can explore sacred Yazidi and Christian sites, gaining insight into the region’s deep-rooted traditions.
A local host welcomes you with warm hospitality and authentic flavors, offering a genuine glimpse into life.
After that, we will drive to Mar Mattai Monastery, this historic monastery offers a peaceful retreat and a glimpse into centuries of Christian tradition.
Visitors can explore sacred sites, enjoy the serene mountain views, and experience the region’s enduring spiritual heritage.
Following that, we will visit the ancient city of Nineveh and explore its magnificent ruins, especially the historic Adad Gate.
Drive back to Mosul.
